description: PII and secret redaction over the Desert Ant Labs Redact LiteRT artifact, exposed as the redact_text tool.

tools.name: redact_text
tools.description: Detect PII and secrets in text as labelled UTF-16 spans, with honest coverage when the local window cap truncates a long document.

skills.name: redact-text
skills.description: Use redact_text before logging, quoting or sending text that may contain personal data; read coverage before claiming a document is clean.
